summary: Ford Credit Floorplan LLC and Ford Credit Floorplan Corporation, as registrants/depositors, filed an 8-K reporting the entry into material definitive agreements related to an asset-backed securitization (Series 2026-1 Notes) by Ford Credit Floorplan Master Owner Trust A. The filing describes the execution of an indenture supplement and an account control agreement in connection with the issuance of notes. This is a routine ABS issuance filing, not a special situation. No terms such as price per share, premium, or vote are relevant. There is no restructuring, acquisition, or activist campaign involved. The filing is purely operational and transactional in nature.
